farmans.title: कुण्डली बनाने का असूल व नेकी असूल

farmans.title: ग्रह फल बनाम राशि फल के भेद
farmans.description: Distinguishes between unalterable fate (Grah Phal) and alterable fate (Rashi Phal amenable to remedies).

farmans.title: कायम ग्रह, नेक-बद व मुश्तर्का असर
farmans.description: Defines standing planets (Kayam Grah) that deliver their natural fruit undisturbed by co-occupants.

farmans.title: कालपुरुष मेष लग्न व 12 भाव स्वरूप
farmans.title_en: Fixed Aries Kalpurusha Lagna & House Foundations

farmans.title: मस्नूई ग्रह (कृत्रिम) व प्रसुप्त घर/ग्रह (सोए हुए)
farmans.description: All 5 canonical synthetic pairs and dormancy mechanics (vacant + 0% rays, opposite 7th house empty).
farmans.unresolved_aspects: Multi-planet triple conjunction synthetic synthesis marked UNRESOLVED.

farmans.title: 12 पक्के घर के स्थायी ग्रह स्वामी
farmans.description: Defines permanent lords for all 12 houses (e.g. H1: Sun/Mars, H2: Jup, H4: Moon, H10: Sat).

farmans.title: उपाय नियम: दिन के समय अनिवार्यता व निषेध
farmans.description: Mandates remedies between sunrise and sunset. Forbids donating articles of exalted/benefic planets.

farmans.title: विशिष्ट भाव दान निषेध (चंद्र 6/8/10, रवि 6/10, शनि 1)
farmans.description: Strict textual prohibitions against milk/water charity for Moon in 6/8/10, copper charity for Sun in 6/10, alcohol/oil for Saturn in 1.

farmans.title: साथी ग्रह, कुण्डली मिलान व कुर्बानी का बकरा
farmans.description: Explains how a secondary planet absorbs the affliction of a primary malefic.
farmans.unresolved_aspects: Modern marriage matching composite formulas marked UNRESOLVED.

farmans.title: ग्रहों की स्वाभाविक मित्रता व शत्रुता चक्र
farmans.description: Full classical matrix of natural friends, neutrals, and mutual enemies.

farmans.title: वर्षफल का 120 साला चक्र गणित व शेषफल

farmans.title: टेवे की किस्में: धर्मी, अंधा, रतौंधी, नाबालिग
